name: Breaker's kit
body:
Source Dungeoneer's Handbook pg. 7
Price 353 gp; Weight 40 lbs.
Category Kits
Description
This kit contains all manner of items useful for smashing down doors, creating diversions, and blowing things up. It includes a dose of alchemist’s glueUE, a flask of alchemist’s fire, a crowbar, a drillUE, a fuse grenadeUE, a glass cutterUE, a jetcaster (see page 24), a vial of phosphorescent gel (see page 27), 4 pints of oil, a portable ram, a dose of rusting powderUE, 5 tindertwigs, and a wireUE.
